dedupe_keys.name: eu27 residential building stock from invert ee lab for demand side flexibility modelling 2020 to 2050

description: This dataset contains the residential building stock of the 27 EU member states as projected by the Invert/EE-Lab building stock model under a carbon-neutrality-by-2050 scenario from the ECEMF project, published by Philipp Mascherbauer of TU Wien as input to the FLEX prosumager optimisation model used in an accompanying publication. One Parquet file has 980,730 rows and 177 columns; each row is a building archetype in a country and year (2020 to 2050 in five-year steps), with identifiers, construction period, building category (single-family and small or large multi-family), dwellings per building, geometry (gross and heated floor area, windows, roof area suitable for solar, floors and room height), parameters for an ISO 13790 5R1C thermal model, and further columns on heating systems and stock numbers described on the record. Coverage: EU27. Access: free Zenodo download (April 2026). Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one scenario only, and archetypes represent groups of buildings, not real buildings. Simulation uses: residential heat pump, PV and battery flexibility studies and national demand projections using ready-made 5R1C parameters. Related records: the Invert/EE-Lab model and Hotmaps building stock data.
